Package com.nexuslink.ui.files

Class TransferItem

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.files.TransferItem
public final class TransferItem extends Object
One queued file transfer in a TransferQueue. A plain (JavaFX-free) data holder so the queue logic can be unit-tested without a display; the TransferQueuePanel observes these via the queue's listeners and renders per-row progress.

For an TransferItem.Direction.UPLOAD the source is a local FileItem and destDir is a remote directory; for a TransferItem.Direction.DOWNLOAD the source is a remote FileItem and destDir is a local directory.

    • previouslyAttempted

      public boolean previouslyAttempted()
      True once this item has been attempted at least once before the current try — i.e. there may be a partial file of ours at the destination to resume from. Deliberately not derived from attempts(), which a manual retry resets to restore the auto-retry budget and which therefore cannot distinguish a retry from a first attempt.
